description: This file defines a custom exception class OTPDeliveryMethodInvalidException used within the security exception handling of the Fineract platform, indicating an invalid OTP delivery method.

classes.name: OTPDeliveryMethodInvalidException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that the OTP delivery method provided is invalid or unsupported.

methods.name: OTPDeliveryMethodInvalidException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error message and code indicating invalid OTP delivery method.
